E0424

`` `uninit` needs the low-level memory tier ``.

What

`` `uninit` needs the low-level memory tier ``.

Why

`` `uninit` skips the automatic zero-fill — an expert-tier operation ``.

Fix

add `use core.mem` at the top of this file to opt in.
